subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Moving Averages
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Moving Averages.

hook.text: Last month you sold 100, 120, and 110 units. The average is 110. That's your simplest forecast.

buildup.text: A moving average forecasts by averaging recent demand over a set number of past periods.

discovery.text: It smooths out random noise and reveals the underlying trend. Simple, easy, and surprisingly useful.

twist.text: It gives equal weight to all periods. A spike three months ago affects the forecast as much as last week.

climax.text: Weighted moving averages fix this—giving recent periods more influence than older ones.

punchline.text: Average the past to estimate the future. Start simple.

quiz.question: What is a limitation of simple moving averages?
options: Equal weight to all periods, even old ones
